title: Datadog US1 - Emergency maintenance tonight
text:
Service: Datadog US1
Maintenance: Emergency maintenance tonight
Status: completed
Impact: none
Scheduled for: 2014-10-13T22:00:00.000-04:00
Scheduled until: 2014-10-14T00:00:00.000-04:00
Updates:
- 2014-10-13T21:14:20.114-04:00: completed - Tonight's emergency maintenance is postponed.
- 2014-10-13T21:13:58.897-04:00: scheduled - We are postponing tonight's emergency maintenance until further notice.
- 2014-10-13T21:00:22.374-04:00: scheduled - Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.
- 2014-10-13T17:02:40.989-04:00: scheduled - In order to fix an issue that has caused delays in metrics processing (and caused some spurious alerts to be sent), we will perform maintenance tonight between 22:00 and 00:00 EDT (02:00-04:00 UTC).

During that period, you may come across our 'down' page, but that is to be expected. There may be a brief period during this maintenance window when alerts may not be sent. In this event, we will keep our Status Page updated here. 

*Most importantly*, all of your data will be processed. 

If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us at support@datadoghq.com
